lit.GW170817: Abbott et al. 2017, ApJL 848, L13, doi:10.3847/2041-8213/aa920c, arXiv:1710.05834: -3e-15 < (v_GW - v_EM)/v_EM < +7e-16 from the 1.74 +/- 0.05 s GW-GRB delay [LIT, verified by web search 2026-10-10 by the runner; re-checked by the physics verifier by direct fetch of the arXiv abstract page]

continuum_expectation.analyst_expectation_prerun: p ~ 3.4 from continuum crossings at t ~ 0.18, 0.57, 1.8

heat.threshold_sweep_note: continuum absolute-threshold exponent is p = 2/(1 - 3/(2L)), L = d^2/(4Dt) (Mentat-derived, u7_repairs_v2.json E): always > 2 and diverging near the reach limit, so 4.6 at 1e-3 is continuum behaviour plus an early discrete near field at d = 2; values below 2 are the explicit stencil; the plateau at 1.34 for 1e-20..1e-80 is an artefact of linear interpolation from a zero sample; p = 1.00 is the first-nonzero (one cell per substep) light cone only

t0_density_deficit_uniform_mass.note: rho/rho0 - 1 = P/K for the engine's linear Tait P = K(rho/rho0 - 1); the 7^3 lattice has one bulk parcel (depth 3) and it reads exactly rho0.
